item.description: The meaning of PRODUCT is the number or expression resulting from the multiplication together of two or more numbers or expressions. How to use product in a sentence.

item.title: What is Product? Definition of Product, Product Meaning - The Economic ...
item.description: A product is something people can see or use, made to satisfy what consumers want or need. It can be a tangible item, a service, an experience, or an idea. Key elements of a product are its characteristics, quality, brand, packaging, and cost.

item.title: Product (business) - Wikipedia
item.description: Products are created through processes of design, production, and distribution, and they play a central role in commercial exchange, consumer behavior, and organizational strategy.

item.title: What is Product? Types, Features, & 25 Examples - theMBAins
item.description: A product is an item offered for sale that can be either a physical object or a service, fulfilling customers’ needs or desires. It encompasses tangible items like cars, phones, and appliances, as well as intangible offerings such as software and experiences.

item.title: PRODUCT | English meaning - Cambridge Dictionary
item.description: PRODUCT definition: 1. something that is made to be sold, usually something that is produced by an industrial process…. Learn more.

item.title: What is a Product, Definition of a Product | Marketing Tutor
item.description: Philip Kotler defined a product as: “Anything that can be offered to a market for attention, acquisition, use or consumption that might satisfy a want or need.”

item.title: Product Definition: How To Build a Much-Loved Product - Aha!
item.description: A product is more than what you sell — it is the complete experience a customer has with your company. This guide breaks down what defines a product, the different types, and how product managers can shape offerings that deliver tangible value.

item.title: Product (mathematics) - Simple English Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia
item.description: In mathematics, a product is a number or a quantity obtained by multiplying two or more numbers together. For example: 4 × 7 = 28 Here, the number 28 is called the product of 4 and 7.

item.title: Product - Definition, Meaning & Synonyms | Vocabulary.com
item.description: The word product is often a synonym for "merchandise" — the stuff for sale on the racks and shelves at a store. But a product can also simply be the result or consequence of someone's efforts or a set of circumstances.
